airspace.zh: 奧地利適用歐盟無人機規章（2019/947）：透過奧地利航管公司的 Dronespace 平台登記；開放類超過250公克的無人機須有無人機駕駛證照（A1、A2、A3）。實際飛行前請先查詢最新規定。
airspace.en: Austria applies EU Regulation 2019/947: register through Austro Control's Dronespace portal; drones over 250 g in the open category need a drone pilot's licence (A1, A2, A3). Check the current rules before any real flight.

property.zh: 哈爾施塔特－達赫施泰因世界遺產

tagline.zh-Hant: 從石器時代的鹿角鋤到鐵器時代的「哈爾施塔特文化」
tagline.en: From a stag-horn hoe to the Iron Age culture that bears the town's name

zh: 這裡是奧地利上奧地利邦的哈爾施塔特，
夾在湖與達赫施泰因山之間。
en: This is Hallstatt in Upper Austria,
squeezed between its lake and the Dachstein massif.

zh: 小鎮的財富來自一種東西：鹽。
en: The wealth of this small town came from one thing: salt.

zh: 鎮上最古老的出土物，
是約公元前五千年的鹿角鋤與燧石斧。
en: The oldest finds here are a stag-horn hoe and flint axes
from around 5000 BC.

zh: 聯合國教科文組織寫道，
至少在公元前兩千年，人們就在這裡採鹽。
en: UNESCO notes that salt was being mined here
as early as 2000 BC.

zh: 鎮上的資料則寫，鹽礦從公元前一三〇〇年
開採至今，常被說成「七千年」。
en: Local accounts date mining from 1300 BC to today,
and the town speaks of "7,000 years of salt mining".

zh: 鐵器時代早期，
約公元前八百到四五〇年的文化以這裡為名。
en: An Early Iron Age culture, about 800 to 450 BC,
is named after this town: the Hallstatt culture.

zh: 那些出土文物，如今收藏在鎮上的世界遺產博物館。
en: Its finds are kept in the town's World Heritage Museum.

zh: 在史前礦道裡，還找到了約兩千八百年前的
木樓梯，是歐洲最古老的一座。
en: In the prehistoric tunnels, a wooden staircase about 2,800 years old was found,
the oldest in Europe.

zh: 1734年，礦工在鹽裡發現一具
保存完好的古代礦工遺體。
en: In 1734 the body of an earlier miner was found,
preserved in the salt.

zh: 大約一〇五〇年就有基督徒社群，
最晚在1181年已有一座羅馬式小教堂。
en: A Christian community is assumed from about 1050,
and a small Romanesque church stood here by 1181 at the latest.

zh: 鹽讓這一帶繁榮，
一直到二十世紀中葉。
en: Salt kept the whole region prosperous
until the middle of the 20th century.

zh: 1997年12月，這片鹽業與山湖交織的地景，
列入世界遺產。
en: In December 1997 this landscape of salt, lake and mountain
became World Heritage.

zh: 範圍包括哈爾施塔特、湖、達赫施泰因山塊
與對岸的上特勞恩。
en: It takes in Hallstatt, the lake, the Dachstein massif
and Obertraun on the far shore.

zh: 這座小鎮把名字留給了一個時代，
而鹽，至今仍在山裡開採。
en: The small town gave its name to an era,
and salt is still mined in the mountain today.

title.en: Seven Hundred and Seventy-Eight People by a Lake

tagline.zh-Hant: 教堂、骨堂、木瓦，以及過度觀光的問題
tagline.en: Churches, a charnel house, larch shingles and the problem of too many visitors

zh: 哈爾施塔特很小，
2018年只有七百七十八位居民。
en: Hallstatt is small:
in 2018 it had 778 residents.

zh: 房屋擠在湖的西南岸，
背後就是陡峭的山坡。
en: Its houses crowd the southwestern shore of the lake
with steep slopes right behind them.

zh: 小鎮海拔五百一十一公尺，
全鎮面積約六十平方公里。
en: The town lies at 511 metres
and its municipality covers about 60 square kilometres.

zh: 山坡上的天主教堂旁，
是著名的骨堂。
en: Beside the Catholic parish church on the slope
stands the famous Beinhaus, the charnel house.

zh: 鎮上也有一座新教的基督教堂。
en: The town also has a Protestant church, the Christuskirche.

zh: 山上的髑髏地教堂修復時，
用了大約兩萬四千片彎曲的落葉松木瓦。
en: When the Calvary church was restored,
about 24,000 curved larch shingles were used.

zh: 山上的魯道夫塔，過去是保護鹽場的防禦塔。
en: Up the hill, the Rudolfsturm once guarded the salt works.

zh: 鹽礦今天也是展場，
纜索鐵道爬升約三百六十公尺到高山谷。
en: The salt mine is now also a visitor attraction;
a funicular climbs about 360 metres to the high valley.

zh: 礦道裡大約攝氏八度，
導覽約九十分鐘，還能坐礦工的木滑梯。
en: Inside it is about 8 °C; the tour lasts about 90 minutes
and includes riding the miners' wooden slides.

zh: 觀景台上有一段十二公尺長、
伸出懸崖的步道，俯瞰整個小鎮。
en: A twelve-metre walkway juts out over the drop
with the whole town below.

zh: 這樣的景色吸引大批遊客，
哈爾施塔特常被當作過度觀光的例子。
en: Views like this bring crowds;
Hallstatt is often cited as a case of overtourism.

zh: 往北大約十七公里，
是巴德伊施爾。
en: About 17 kilometres north
lies Bad Ischl.

zh: 城裡的皇帝別墅，
是薩爾茨卡默古特另一個知名去處。
en: Its Kaiservilla is another well-known stop
in the Salzkammergut.

zh: 山與湖之間只有一條窄窄的岸，
小鎮就在這條岸上住了幾千年。
en: Between mountain and lake there is only a narrow shore,
and the town has lived on it for thousands of years.

title.en: Glaciers, Ice Caves and a Mountain Lake

tagline.zh-Hant: 達赫施泰因山塊、戈紹山脊與薩爾茨卡默古特的湖泊
tagline.en: The Dachstein massif, the Gosaukamm and the lakes of the Salzkammergut

zh: 薩爾茨卡默古特是奧地利的湖區，
哈爾施塔特湖是其中一座。
en: The Salzkammergut is Austria's lake district,
and Hallstätter See is one of its lakes.

zh: 湖的南端被高山圍住，
北端才通往較開闊的河谷。
en: Its southern end is closed in by high mountains;
only the north opens into a wider valley.

zh: 往南，是達赫施泰因山塊。
en: To the south rises the Dachstein massif.

zh: 山上還有冰河，
也是世界遺產範圍的一部分。
en: It still carries glaciers,
and the massif is part of the World Heritage property.

zh: 這座石灰岩高原底下，
藏著大大小小的洞穴。
en: Beneath this limestone plateau
lie caves large and small.

zh: 這一帶有達赫施泰因冰洞、猛獁洞
與科本布呂勒洞。
en: Here are the Dachstein Ice Cave, the Mammoth Cave
and the Koppenbrüller Cave.

zh: 克里彭施泰因峰，
也在這片山塊上。
en: The Krippenstein
belongs to the same massif.

zh: 往西是戈紹山脊，
一道陡峭的山稜。
en: To the west runs the Gosaukamm,
a steep mountain ridge.

zh: 它是上奧地利邦與薩爾斯堡邦的界山。
en: It runs along the border of Upper Austria and Salzburg.

zh: 世界遺產名單上，
這裡登錄為「持續演變中的文化景觀」。
en: On the World Heritage List it is a "continuing cultural landscape":
nature and human use shaped together.

zh: 往北過了巴德伊施爾，
是另一座大湖，沃夫岡湖。
en: North beyond Bad Ischl
lies another large lake, the Wolfgangsee.

zh: 薩爾茨卡默古特的湖泊，
一座接著一座。
en: The Salzkammergut's lakes
follow one after another.

zh: 回到哈爾施塔特，
湖面、森林與冰河都在同一個畫面裡。
en: Back at Hallstatt,
lake, forest and glacier share a single view.

zh: 這片風景是山、水與時間一起做出來的。
en: This landscape was made by mountains, water and time together.

title.en: Salt from a Sea, Mined from a Mountain

tagline.zh-Hant: 兩億三千萬年前的潟湖，怎麼變成阿爾卑斯山裡的鹽礦
tagline.en: How lagoons of 230 million years ago became salt inside the Alps

zh: 為什麼阿爾卑斯山裡會有鹽？
答案要回到兩億五千萬年前。
en: Why is there salt inside the Alps?
The answer goes back 250 million years.

zh: 兩億五千萬年前，這一帶還在水下。
en: More than 250 million years ago, this area was under water.

zh: 大約兩億三千萬年前，
古特提斯海的溫暖潟湖蒸發出鹽層。
en: About 230 million years ago, salt formed
in the warm lagoons of the ancient Tethys.

zh: 約一億兩千萬年前，
達赫施泰因的石灰岩高原疊在鹽層上方。
en: Around 120 million years ago,
the Dachstein limestone plateau built up over the salt.

zh: 約五千萬年前，板塊移動把這些地層
擠成阿爾卑斯山的鹽礦床。
en: About 50 million years ago, moving plates
pushed these layers into the alpine salt deposits.

zh: 鹽礦就在小鎮上方的高山谷裡。
en: The salt mine lies in the high valley above the town.

zh: 纜索鐵道從湖邊爬升約三百六十公尺，
才到得了礦區。
en: A funicular climbs about 360 metres from the lakeside
to reach the mine.

zh: 小鎮本身在海拔五百一十一公尺，
擠在湖岸與山壁之間。
en: The town itself lies at 511 metres,
pressed between shore and rock wall.

zh: 湖的南端緊貼著達赫施泰因山塊。
en: The southern end of the lake runs right up against the Dachstein massif.

zh: 石灰岩被水溶蝕，
在山裡留下洞穴與冰洞。
en: Water dissolves limestone,
leaving caves and ice caves inside the mountain.

zh: 往西，是戈紹山脊。
en: To the west lies the Gosaukamm.

zh: 山稜的形狀，
從空中看得最清楚。
en: Seen from the air,
the shape of its crest is easiest to read.

zh: 鹽在地下，石灰岩在上，
人住在兩者之間的湖岸。
en: Salt below, limestone above,
and people living on the shore between them.

zh: 一座小鎮的歷史，
是從兩億多年前的一片海開始的。
en: A small town's history
begins with a sea more than 200 million years ago.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Hallstatt-Dachstein / Salzkammergut Cultural Landscape
